Created the ESM port in `/output` with local `.mjs` modules:

- [currency-data.mjs](/output/lib/currency-data.mjs)
- [number-format.mjs](/output/lib/number-format.mjs)
- [cli.mjs](/output/lib/cli.mjs)
- [money.mjs](/output/lib/money.mjs)
- [test10.mjs](/output/test10.mjs)

The implementation is dependency-free, uses only local `import` paths, manually parses `process.argv`, preserves argparse-style help/error behavior, and matches the executable’s money formatting details including `U+00A0` spacing, currency-specific symbols/precision, half-even rounding, negative zero, and `NaN`/`INF` cases.

Verification: I byte-compared the Node output against `/workspace/dataset/test10_executable` across the sample cases and additional edge cases including `USD`, `CHF`, `CNY`, `EUR`, `JPY`, `XOF`, `TWD`, `AUD`, `XTS`, lowercase currency codes, rounding boundaries, and parser failures/help. The only intentional text difference is the program name in help/error output: Node reports `test10.mjs` instead of `test10_executable`.
